card.name: Linking word before a measured change
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'of', 'in' or 'was' right after a measurement noun like blood pressure, change from baseline or dose, just before the number or value is given. Also 'ose' in 'Absorbed Dose' in radiation tables.

modes.label: Change from baseline
modes.description: 'of' or 'in' after 'mean change/increase from baseline', leading into the value.
modes.example: mean changes from baseline<< in>> lipid values are presented in Table 7

modes.label: Blood pressure decrease
modes.description: 'of' or 'was' after a blood pressure noun, before the mmHg figure.
modes.example: mean maximum decrease in supine blood pressure<< of>> 7 mmHg systolic and
